key_insight: RASPER improves EHR prediction by training a note summarizer to keep only the patient-specific evidence that helps the downstream clinical task.
clinical_relevance: This could make discharge-note use in hospital prediction models more accurate by filtering noisy text while preserving information that complements structured codes.
method: Uses an LLM-based summarizer for discharge notes.
Optimizes summaries with reinforcement learning from downstream prediction loss as the reward.
Injects structured-code context through a longitudinal encoder that creates soft prompts for each patient.
evidence_signal: According to the abstract, RASPER outperforms strong baselines on readmission prediction and medication recommendation using MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.
watch_item: Performance depends on a task-specific reward and model integration, so results may not transfer cleanly to other clinical settings or summary targets.
paper_title: RASPER: Reward-Aligned Summarization of Clinical Notes for EHR Outcome Prediction
